law_name: Law No. CXCVII of 2017 on the Protection of Copyright on Intellectual Works and Related Rights (Vatican City State), replacing Law No. CXXXII of 2011
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years; 70 years after publication for works without a named author
author_rights: Holy See and Vatican City State hold exclusive economic rights in works made or published under their name or on their commission, for 70 years (Art. 5); Italian Law 633/1941 supplements (Art. 1)
moral_rights: Holy See and Vatican City State keep the right to claim authorship and to oppose distortion or modification, even after transfer (Art. 6); Italian Law 633/1941 supplements (Art. 1)
fair_use_exceptions: Italian Law 633/1941 applies as supplementary law (Art. 1). Pope's image needs no consent for religious, cultural, educational or scientific purposes or public events (Art. 3(3))
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Commission (Art. 7) coordinates copyright administration; competence disputes go to the Secretariat of State after conciliation. Law issued by the Pontifical Commission
notes: Promulgated 1 Sep 2017, in force 1 Oct 2017. Holy See owns copyright in works published under its name or on its commission. Berne member since 12 Sep 1935 per Commons (another source cites 1975). Earlier Law XII of 12 Jan 1960 and 2011 law are repealed.
